lessonTitle: The MSL as strategic medical partner

slides.title: From Field Scientist to Strategic Partner
bullets: The modern MSL shapes evidence-generation strategy, not just executes it
This shift mirrors Medical Affairs' broader evolution covered in Module 1
From reactive support function to strategic pillar

slides.title: Identify Gaps, Don't Wait to Be Told
bullets: A strategic MSL doesn't wait for a Medical Advisor to define the questions
They actively identify where the organisation's evidence base has gaps
They design scientific-exchange priorities around closing those gaps
Coordinated with the broader Medical Plan

slides.title: Treat Insight as a Strategic Input
bullets: Every significant field insight is a potential input to strategy
Not just a data point to log
A strategic MSL can clearly explain why an insight matters
And what decision it should inform

slides.title: Beyond Your Own Territory
bullets: Recognise patterns relevant across a region or therapeutic area
Contribute to internal communities of practice
Understand how local intelligence fits the company's global strategy

slides.title: Fundamentals Are the Entry Price
bullets: Not every MSL needs to become a strategist overnight
Accurate exchange, territory discipline and documentation still matter
They are the entry price, not the ceiling

slides.title: Always Ask the "So What"
bullets: Not just what a KOL said, but what it means for the evidence agenda
Not just how many visits happened, but what changed as a result
This is what distinguishes the MSLs who progress fastest

takeaway.title: The modern MSL earns a seat in strategy by acting like a partner, not an executor
bullets: Strategic MSLs proactively close evidence gaps instead of waiting to be asked
They connect local territory intelligence to the company's broader strategy
Field fundamentals remain the foundation everything else is built on
